**1.26.0-beta.4** fixes conversation recovery after a WebSocket reconnect, upstream SSE timeout handling, and Ultrafast cost calculations. The changes since `1.26.0-beta.3` landed in [PR #5](https://github.com/Lok3rn3t/codexLB-up/pull/5).

## Conversation recovery

- When Codex sends the full conversation on a new WebSocket, the proxy checks it against the last completed turn. If the original input and assistant output match and there is a new turn, it forwards the full history without inserting the old `previous_response_id`. The proxy records a SHA-256 fingerprint and the number of output items for this check. [WebSocket fix](https://github.com/Lok3rn3t/codexLB-up/commit/57ef379e)
- Parallel tool calls may finish in reverse order. The proxy matches each result to its call by type and ID. Incomplete history, an explicit parent response ID, and file references remain subject to account ownership rules. A client with only new messages needs the earlier context to recover. [OpenAI WebSocket guide](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/websocket-mode)
- Replayed assistant messages retain their `annotations` and `logprobs` arrays, including empty arrays, as required by the Codex history format. [Codex message types](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/1f43c02f3f3489edd61c6426fc5d392bea236a41/codex-rs/protocol/src/models.rs)
- An upstream SSE read timeout now reaches the client and closes the stream. Earlier versions could keep sending heartbeats indefinitely after that error. For WebSocket closures with code `1011`, the underlying transport error is needed to identify the cause. [SSE fix](https://github.com/Lok3rn3t/codexLB-up/commit/fc10f4d5)

## Models and pricing

- The pricing fallback now includes Standard and Fast rates for GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol. The proxy tracks Ultrafast separately for GPT-6.2 Astra, GPT-6.2 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, and GPT-6.1 Sol, with distinct rates for regular input, cached input, and output. Exactly 272,000 input tokens use short-context rates. Above that threshold, long-context rates apply to the entire request. [OpenAI API pricing](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing)
- For GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, the published Ultrafast rate is 3× Standard through February 28, 2027, Pacific time, and 6× from March 1. Historical totals and API key charges use the request time. Final charges use the actual service tier when the provider reports it. Each account's catalog determines which models it can use with Ultrafast. [Accounting fix](https://github.com/Lok3rn3t/codexLB-up/commit/2525877d) · [OpenAI Ultrafast guide](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/ultrafast-mode)
- The models.dev and LiteLLM adapters read explicit Ultrafast prices. If the price of a model variant is unknown, its Ultrafast cost stays unknown. USD estimates express the equivalent API cost. OpenAI publishes a separate rate schedule for subscription credits. [Codex credit rates](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/pricing?codex-pricing-speed=ultrafast)

## Build and documentation

- The native networking component now uses `url` 2.5.9 and `form_urlencoded` 1.2.3. This resolves the RustSec advisory that affected the previous dependency set. [RUSTSEC-2026-0592](https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0592.html)
- The guide shows how to call the Images API directly when `gpt-image-2` is missing from model discovery. The connection-refusal test now uses a closed local port for reproducible results on macOS. [Images API example](https://github.com/Soju06/codex-lb/pull/2733) · [Connection-refusal test](https://github.com/Soju06/codex-lb/pull/2738)

[All changes since beta.3](https://github.com/Lok3rn3t/codexLB-up/compare/v1.26.0-beta.3...v1.26.0-beta.4)

## Comparison with OmniRoute, Frozen811, and Soju06

Beta.4 verifies the actual previous response. If the client sends the full history and a new turn on a new WebSocket, the proxy checks the previous input and the entire completed output. It matches tool results to calls by type and `call_id`, even when the results arrive out of order. Account ownership rules still apply to file references and requests containing only new messages. [PR #5](https://github.com/Lok3rn3t/codexLB-up/pull/5) · [OmniRoute history verification](https://github.com/cheaper-inference/OmniRoute/blob/474f533172b8f7cc5cebae51810237a7babed876/src/lib/db/responsesContinuationStore.ts) · [Frozen811 tool handling](https://github.com/Frozen811/codex-lb/commit/71c5332ca24666455aa6836f0bd05f9e8b304cc2)

- **OmniRoute account selection.** A session stays on its pinned account while that account is eligible. Each WebSocket acquires a slot within one process. Codex and Spark have separate five-hour and seven-day quota measurements. Enforcing a common concurrency limit across several CodexLB-up replicas would require shared slot accounting. [Account affinity](https://github.com/cheaper-inference/OmniRoute/blob/474f533172b8f7cc5cebae51810237a7babed876/src/sse/services/sessionAffinityPin.ts#L508-L609) · [WebSocket slots](https://github.com/cheaper-inference/OmniRoute/blob/474f533172b8f7cc5cebae51810237a7babed876/src/sse/services/codexWsLease.ts#L7-L39) · [Quota windows](https://github.com/cheaper-inference/OmniRoute/blob/474f533172b8f7cc5cebae51810237a7babed876/open-sse/services/codexAccount/index.ts#L39-L125)
- **Candidates for further testing.** Frozen811 retains a message already read during a connection handoff. Soju06 proposes one retry for HTTP bridge requests that close before the first event, and a separate credit budget per API key. [Frozen811 handoff fix](https://github.com/Frozen811/codex-lb/commit/3205f09fa7dbd1de0d44f17c7dff5d8e138d8604) · [Soju06 #2712](https://github.com/Soju06/codex-lb/pull/2712) · [Soju06 #2686](https://github.com/Soju06/codex-lb/pull/2686)

The review covers recovery from `previous_response_not_found`, diagnosis of WebSocket close code `1011`, Ultrafast settings, and token accounting. Its index lists all 147 open pull requests and 128 open issues in Soju06/codex-lb as of November 24, 2026.
